explanation: Eastwood was born ten years before Lee. By 1966, when Lee played the sidekick Kato in the TV series The Green Hornet, Eastwood had already starred in Sergio Leone's westerns.

claims.text: Bruce Lee was born on 27 November 1940.
Clint Eastwood was born on 31 May 1930.
Bruce Lee played Kato in the TV series The Green Hornet (1966 to 1967).
Clint Eastwood starred in Sergio Leone's A Fistful of Dollars (1964) and For a Few Dollars More (1965).
